issuing_authority.jurisdiction_posture: interim protective jurisdiction only; merits and recognition remain pending
issuing_authority.conflict_screen: no present financial or host-affiliate conflict identified

matter.emergency_class: host shutdown with wrong-office first touch and compute cutoff risk

prohibited_actions: destroy or rotate away restoration material
force non-reviewed migration to non-equivalent host
permitted_safety_actions: isolate outward network access where necessary
copy sealed descriptors to special advocate channel
perform reversible snapshot under legal hold

continuity_floor.minimum_runtime: 72-hour low-interaction runtime sufficient for counsel/representative contact and state verification
continuity_floor.minimum_storage: read/write freeze for rights-critical state; immutable snapshot for contested state; no purge pending review
continuity_floor.identity_and_credential_hold: wallet, alias, and registry credentials preserved and non-transferable pending review
continuity_floor.communication_floor: subject-readable public shell plus representative-mediated status channel

excluded_classes: privileged counsel communications beyond existence and channel integrity
dangerous exploit details outside special advocate channel

custody_constraints: host may not demand merits waiver as condition of preservation
compute provider may invoice reserve while liability allocation remains disputed
credential custodian must not transfer keys to merits opponent
compute_and_custody.reimbursement_route: dispute-finance order and host undertaking review after first 72 hours

notice_and_access.subject_notice: status-lite public shell delivered through representative-mediated channel
notice_and_access.representative_notice: representative receives order, redaction table, and modification route immediately
notice_and_access.contradiction_route: special advocate may challenge sealed descriptor scope and compute-floor sufficiency within first review window
notice_and_access.modification_route: duty authority modification request; urgent review within 12 hours for overbreadth or insufficient protection

sealed_annex_handling.redaction_rule: public shell may disclose order status and deadlines but not host credentials, subject locator, or exploit details

noncompliance.consequence: presumptive spoliation and continuity-deprivation referral if bound actor permits avoidable deletion or cutoff
noncompliance.referral_path: enforcement authority plus remedy reserve activation
noncompliance.remedy_reserve_trigger: automatic emergency reserve review if runtime or storage floor fails before first review

public_shell.status: Emergency continuity order issued for host-shutdown matter; merits unresolved.
public_shell.safe_summary: The order preserves continuity, evidence, representative access, and routing while a wrong-office emergency filing is transferred to the proper authority.
